name: @noviscia/sdk
description: Universal Noviscia developer SDK — program IDs + address derivation, anchor program wrappers, the Unified Collateral Gateway, payload translators, and a simulate-first sandbox.

scripts.build: npm run clean && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && npm run copy:idls
scripts.copy:idls: mkdir -p dist/idl && for f in ../target/idl/*.json; do name=$(basename "$f"); case "$name" in benchmarks.json|bug_bounty.json|burn_engine.json|escrow.json|protocol_lp_vault.json|sol_vault.json) continue;; esac; cp -n "$f" dist/idl/; done; ls dist/idl/*.json 2>/dev/null | wc -l | xargs -I{} echo 'Copied {} IDLs'
scripts.prepublishOnly: npm run typecheck && npm run build && npm test
